title: L1-L5 total ROM under 7.5 Nm pure moments, in vitro reference (Rohlmann 2001b, re-plotted in Dreischarf 2014)

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: total L1-L5 rotation over the full motion range (flexion+extension, left+right lateral bending, left+right axial rotation) at +/-7.5 Nm pure moment, no preload; median and range (min-max) of 10 specimens as re-plotted by Dreischarf 2014 Fig 2a (red bars)

source.authors: Dreischarf M, Zander T, Shirazi-Adl A, Puttlitz CM, Adam CJ, Chen CS, Goel VK, Kiapour A, Kim YH, Labus KM, Little JP, Park WM, Wang YH, Wilke HJ, Rohlmann A, Schmidt H
source.n: 10 specimens (L1-L5, from Rohlmann et al. 2001b Spine 26:E557)
source.sample: human cadaveric L1-L5 lumbar spines, 10 specimens (primary: Rohlmann A, Neller S, Claes L, Bergmann G, Wilke HJ 2001, Spine 26:E557-E561)

protocol.summary: Pure moments 7.5 Nm in flexion/extension, lateral bending, axial rotation (Wilke 1998 recommendations); no follower preload for this comparison; L1-L5 total rotation. Rate/cycles not restated in Dreischarf 2014 (see primary Rohlmann 2001b).
how_to_simulate: Model L1-L5 osseoligamentous spine, fix L5 (all DOF) - Dreischarf: 6 of 8 models fixed L5; 2 models included L5-S1 fixed at S1
Apply unconstrained pure moment 7.5 Nm to L1 in each direction, no preload
Report total L1-L5 rotation summed over both directions (flexion+extension, left+right LB, left+right AR)
protocol.notes: Secondary data: values re-plotted from Rohlmann 2001b; use the primary when available. Text of Dreischarf 2014: in vitro medians differ from FE-model medians by ~2 deg (FE), ~1 deg (LB), ~5 deg (AR). Figures in the QUT eprints author version are low-resolution embedded bitmaps (~550x420 px for a 4-panel figure); digitised by pixel analysis of the extracted image against gridlines.

extraction.from: Fig 2a (red bars, in vitro median and range)
extraction.check_notes: Axis calibrated on gridlines (rows 43=45 deg ... 92=25 deg, 2.46 px/deg). Re-digitised bar tops by column scan: FE 31.2, LB 34.1, AR 11.3-11.7 (outline) -> 11.5. Consistency check: text says FE medians differ from in vitro by ~2 (FE 34 vs 31.2), ~1 (LB 35 vs 34.1), ~5 deg (AR 17 vs 11.5) - consistent.

pass_rule.rule: min <= model <= max (PASS); also compare with 8-model range (fe_model_comparison.dreischarf2014.L1L5_models_rom_pure_moment)

shared_sample_with: rohlmann2001b: primary source of these 10 specimens (Spine 26:E557, not in bench PDFs)
